scope: N420 embedded sign-in opens complete URL tokens across terminal reads

baseline.defect: Per-read URL parsing auto-opened valid but truncated prefixes or lost fragmented schemes; cancellation could already have opened an incomplete address.

behavior: Only whitespace-delimited complete prefix enters unchanged public find_urls; unfinished final token carries across reads, including partial scheme/host/path.
Known process exit flushes the final unterminated token even with an empty last read; normal cancellation does not parse pending text.
Preserves immediate complete URL delivery, first-URL-only automatic opening, order/dedup/latest manual opening and existing cleanup of complete ANSI sequences.
No timer debounce, retry, new helper/module, public signature/prose or runtime-caption changes.

checks.API_source: Every module/class/function docstring and signature AST-identical to source base

limits: Browser callback is mocked; existing process checks use only disposable local Python stand-ins, no vendor authentication/account/network action.
Incomplete tokens remain pending while a process stays open without a delimiter; there is no timer assumption that a valid prefix is a complete address.
ANSI escape sequences split internally across polling reads remain a separate parser issue; no universal ANSI streaming claim.
Windows fallback/native desktop/vendor authentication and whole item420 acceptance remain unclaimed.
